atoms.text: This is Dusty the Dog. He is going to show you around a farm.

instruction.text: Answer Dusty’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>What is a farm?</voice>

b.sound: A farm is an area of land that produces food from plants or animals.
A farm is a shopping centre for dogs to buy new clothes.

instruction.text: Plants that are grown on farms are called crops. Select the three images of farm crops.

feedback.finish: Great! Different types of crops grow in different ways - for example, on trees, on bushes or in the ground!
feedback.wrong: These are sweets, which can’t be grown.

instruction.text: This is an apple orchard. Select the closest tree to learn more.

feedback.end: An orchard is an area full of fruit trees and shrubs. This is where crops such as apples, pears and oranges are grown!

instruction.text: This is a wheat field. Select the farm vehicle to learn more.

feedback.end: Wheat is needed to make lots of food, such as bread, pizza and cake! Wheat fields can cover huge amounts of land, so harvesters can help with collecting it.

instruction.text: This is a carrot field. Select the carrot leaves to learn more.

feedback.end: Vegetables often grow in the ground or close to the ground. Farmers will need to use their strength to pull them out when they’re ready!

atoms.a: “In which of these places might you find farms?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>In which of these places might you find farms?</voice>

feedback.end: Farms are found in the countryside as they need large areas of land to grow crops.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Dusty wants to find out what there is on this farm. Select the correct places on the farm map.
You are now by the house on the farm with Dusty. Answer Dusty’s questions.

atoms.a: “How do we get to the fruit orchard?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>How do we get to the fruit orchard?</voice>

atoms.a: “How do we get to the windmill?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>How do we get to the windmill?</voice>
ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>In which direction is the barn?</voice>

feedback.end: Great work! You can visit a farm yourself to see where all your fruits and vegetables come from. A lot of farms even allow you to pick your own!
